games.Author: josvitorkjr45
games.GameInfoText: Follow Vito Scaletta and his friend Joe through Empire Bay as their attempts to rise through the mob put their loyalties to the test.

LaunchIssues.Guess: M2VR needs an active 32-bit OpenXR runtime, Vulkan and the x86 Visual C++ runtime.
LaunchIssues.Label: Mafia II does not start in VR
Steps: Confirm this is Mafia II Classic, then connect the headset and check that the active runtime supports 32-bit OpenXR.
Install Microsoft's Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x86) from the link in the publisher guide if it is missing.

games.Quip: The view from the wheel in Empire Bay is something else.
games.Title: Mafia II (Classic) VR
UninstallSteps: Close the game and M2VR Launcher. In Windows Installed apps, uninstall Mafia II Classic VR MOD.
The publisher uninstaller restores the original game executable. Scan installed games after removal.
_UninstallGuide: Close the game and M2VR Launcher. In Windows Installed apps, uninstall Mafia II Classic VR MOD.
The publisher uninstaller restores the original game executable. Scan installed games after removal.

games.Author: Trilex
games.GameInfoText: Play as Jackie Estacado in a first-person shooter about organized crime and the supernatural power he carries. Wield firearms and unleash the Darkness in close combat.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The gesture requires both buttons on the weapon hand to be released.
LaunchIssues.Label: Lowering the weapon does not reload it
Steps: Lower the weapon hand to the upper thigh and hold it there briefly without squeezing grip or the front trigger.
Use A/Cross or X/Square for the standard reload action if the gesture is awkward.

games.Quip: Embrace the Darkness. Keep both hands free.
games.Title: The Darkness II VR
UninstallSteps: Open Trilex Mod Installer through Install / Repair and select The Darkness II and the same game folder.
Choose Restore / uninstall. Trilex restores the originals it recorded for that installation.
_UninstallGuide: Open Trilex Mod Installer through Install / Repair and select The Darkness II and the same game folder.
Choose Restore / uninstall. Trilex restores the originals it recorded for that installation.

games.Author: Trilex
games.GameInfoText: Create a hero for Tiny Tina's tabletop-inspired campaign. Combine classes, collect weapons and cast spells as you hunt the Dragon Lord.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The Trilex VR runtime requires DirectX 11.
LaunchIssues.Label: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands opens flat after a manual launch
Steps: Use Start in VR in the Hub. If launching through Steam manually, set -dx11 in the game's launch options and remove any explicit DX12 option.
Connect the headset before restarting the game.

games.Notice: Steam edition. The VR mod needs DirectX 11. DLSS Quality can render in one eye only.
games.Quip: Roll for initiative. Aim with both hands.
games.Title: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands
UninstallSteps: Open Trilex Mod Installer through Install / Repair, select Tiny Tina's Wonderlands and its Steam folder, then choose Restore / uninstall.
_UninstallGuide: Open Trilex Mod Installer through Install / Repair, select Tiny Tina's Wonderlands and its Steam folder, then choose Restore / uninstall.

games.Author: PeCOS2k5
games.GameInfoText: Roam the open world of Myrtana as the Nameless Hero. Take sides in the conflict with the orcs, build your skills and explore settlements, deserts and mountain regions.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The launcher may be using a different OpenXR provider from the one connected to your headset.
LaunchIssues.Label: The game opens flat on the monitor
Steps: Open Gothic 3 VR Launcher and select the OpenXR runtime for your headset.
Connect the headset through that provider, then run Camera & controls → Check installation before trying again.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The active OpenXR controller profile determines which inputs the mod can use.
LaunchIssues.Label: Some controller buttons do not respond
Steps: In the launcher, open Headset setup → Start headset setup → Test controls.
Use Remap controls to assign a button that the test detects. You can also open Main menu from the VR radial.

games.Notice: Start Gothic 3 Classic flat once. The Hub can copy it to a separate VR folder or use a copy you already have. Publisher setup installs the required patches and offers manual recovery. In the VR launcher, match the OpenXR runtime to your headset connection so the VR controllers respond.
games.Quip: Welcome to Myrtana. Draw your bow by hand.
games.Title: Gothic 3 VR
UninstallSteps: Close the game and the VR launcher. In Windows Installed apps, uninstall Gothic 3 VR.
The publisher uninstaller restores its backed-up files and retains saves and settings.
_UninstallGuide: Close the game and the VR launcher. In Windows Installed apps, uninstall Gothic 3 VR.
The publisher uninstaller restores its backed-up files and retains saves and settings.

games.Author: 7DaysVR Team
games.GameInfoText: 7 Days to Die is an open-world game that is a unique combination of first-person shooter, survival horror, tower defense, and role-playing games. Play the definitive zombie survival sandbox RPG that came first. Navezgane awaits!

LaunchIssues.Guess: 7DVR 4.1 and later use OpenXR. For Virtual Desktop the mod guide calls for VDXR.
LaunchIssues.Label: 7 Days to Die opens the wrong runtime in Virtual Desktop
Steps: Close the game and select VDXR in Virtual Desktop Streamer.
Connect the headset and use Start in VR in the Hub with SteamVR closed.

games.Title: 7 Days to Die VR
_UninstallGuide: Close 7 Days to Die VR and its launcher before changing files.
For temporary flat play, use the Flat / VR switch on this page. It parks the VR loader or plugin and is fully reversible.
Remove only the VR-specific plugin path or parked counterpart that applies to this install: 'BepInEx\plugins\7DaysVR.dll'.

Do not delete the whole BepInEx folder, Plugins folder, config folder, or winhttp.dll while another mod may use them. Those are shared loader components, not proof that every file belongs to this VR mod.

For a completely clean loader removal, compare the installed files with the package on the linked mod page and remove only matching package files. A store file check can restore changed game files, but it does not reliably remove added mod files.

games.Author: Game Or Die
games.GameInfoText: Play as a giant and help the tiny Keflings build a kingdom, unlocking blueprints and new buildings as the village grows. The VR port presents the world as a living tabletop model with controller or gamepad input. The licensed PC game is required.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The grip mouse still points into the world. The cursor arrow is drawn only on the menu panel.
LaunchIssues.Label: The pointer vanishes past the edge of the menu screen
Steps: Look at the game's object highlight when pointing past the panel.
Aim back onto the menu panel to see the cursor arrow again.

games.Quip: A giant hand in the kingdom is helpful until it starts redecorating.
games.Title: A Kingdom for Keflings VR
UninstallSteps: Close A Kingdom for Keflings, then use Uninstall now to remove unchanged Hub-owned VR files and restore prior same-name files.
The licensed game, saves, personal settings, changed files and unrelated files remain.
For a publisher setup installed outside the Hub, use its VR\\UNINSTALL.bat instead.
_UninstallGuide: Close A Kingdom for Keflings, then use Uninstall now to remove unchanged Hub-owned VR files and restore prior same-name files.
The licensed game, saves, personal settings, changed files and unrelated files remain.
For a publisher setup installed outside the Hub, use its VR\\UNINSTALL.bat instead.

games.Author: King-EJ
games.GameInfoText: A retro spy shooter inspired by 1990s console classics. Complete objectives, steal secret plans and fight through guarded locations as secret agent John Walter.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The mod maps each game action in the Controls section of its configuration.
LaunchIssues.Label: Agent 64 reloads on the wrong VR button
Steps: After the first run, open BepInEx\config\agent64.vr.cfg.
Under [Controls], set Reload to the desired input, for example MainGrip. The mod applies these edits live.

games.Quip: For England? No, for stereoscopic depth.
games.Title: Agent 64: Spies Never Die VR
UninstallSteps: Close the game. Uninstall now removes unchanged Hub-owned VR files and restores backed-up originals.
The shared loader remains when other plugins need it. Changed settings, saves and unrelated files are kept.

The shared loader remains when other plugins need it. Changed settings, saves and unrelated files are kept.

games.Author: fholger
games.GameInfoText: A Dark Presence stalks the small town of Bright Falls, pushing Alan Wake to the brink of sanity in his fight to unravel the mystery and save his love.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The mod targets the original Alan Wake from Steam, GOG or Epic.
LaunchIssues.Label: Alan Wake Remastered does not load the mod
Steps: In the store library, check that the installed title is the original Alan Wake.
Use that game's folder for the VR setup. The Remastered executable is not supported by this mod.

games.Notice: Original Alan Wake only; Remastered is unsupported. Steam, GOG and Epic editions are supported by the publisher. Set your OpenXR runtime before Start in VR. Quest owners should use Steam Link or Virtual Desktop; Meta Horizon Link currently does not work.
games.Quip: The darkness has a new dimension.
games.SupportText: fholger makes this free VR mod. If you enjoy it, you can support the author:
games.Title: Alan Wake VR

The game, saves, settings and unrelated files remain. If any owned file changed after installation, removal pauses for review instead of overwriting it.

games.Author: (auto-update) Nibre + JayP
games.GameInfoText: Discover the true meaning of fear in Alien: Isolation, a survival horror set in an atmosphere of constant dread and mortal danger.

LaunchIssues.Guess: GRAND uses a physical throwing gesture. A fixed-velocity option is also available.
LaunchIssues.Label: IED drops instead of being thrown
Steps: Hold grip, swing your hand and release grip during the throw.
If you prefer the old fixed-velocity throw, close the game and set DisableIEDPhysicalThrowing=1 in grand.ini.

games.Title: Alien: Isolation VR
_UninstallGuide: Close Alien: Isolation VR and its launcher before changing files.
The Hub verifies the VR installation with 'dxgi.dll'. This identifies the mod but is not automatically a complete removal list.
Open the linked mod page below and compare its current package or author removal section with the files in your game folder. Remove only files confirmed to belong to this VR mod.

If the mod replaced an original game file and supplied no backup or uninstaller, preserve your settings and use the store launcher repair/verify command. Verification restores original files but may leave added mod files behind.
Never uninstall the base game or delete the whole game folder just to remove a VR mod.

games.Author: Bassquake
games.GameInfoText: Aliens versus Predator lets you play as a Marine, Alien or Predator. Each campaign gives the same locations a different pace and set of tools: armed survival, wall-crawling pursuit or a hunter's cloak and vision modes. This community port adds tracked PCVR play and also supports LAN multiplayer with other supported builds.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The mod author identifies the standard edition's language.txt as incompatible.
LaunchIssues.Label: AvP VR crashes with original CD data
Steps: Use the game's Gold Edition assets. If using standard edition data, supply language.txt from the Gold Edition.
Launch the PCVR version again after correcting the game assets.

games.Notice: A licensed Gold Edition AvP game and its game assets are required. The publisher says the ordinary edition language.txt can crash the port; the Hub cannot identify that edition by filename.
games.Quip: In space, no one can hear your motion sickness. Watch those walls.
games.Title: Aliens versus Predator VR
UninstallSteps: Close Aliens versus Predator, then use Uninstall now. Unchanged Hub-owned runtime files are removed and any original same-name files restored.
Licensed game data, saves, profiles, configuration, CD music and changed files stay in place. The Gold Edition language.txt is your responsibility.
_UninstallGuide: Close Aliens versus Predator, then use Uninstall now. Unchanged Hub-owned runtime files are removed and any original same-name files restored.
Licensed game data, saves, profiles, configuration, CD music and changed files stay in place. The Gold Edition language.txt is your responsibility.

games.Author: Bassquake
games.GameInfoText: Play through three distinct single-player storylines from the perspectives of a Colonial Marine, an Alien, and a Predator, each offering completely different gameplay mechanics and traversal styles.

LaunchIssues.Guess: This mod uses a 32-bit VR application; the mod author tested the PC route through Steam Link.
LaunchIssues.Label: AvP2 opens but does not appear in the headset with Meta Link
Steps: On a supported Quest headset, connect to SteamVR via Steam Link instead of Meta Link.
With the headset connected, retry the same AvP2 VR launch.

games.Quip: Game over, man! Try the other two campaigns.

games.GameInfoText: Amnesia: The Dark Descent, a first person survival horror. A game about immersion, discovery and living through a nightmare. An experience that will chill you to the core.

Steps: Keep your owned copy of Amnesia: The Dark Descent installed.
Use Start in VR on the Sclerosis detail page. If its base game was moved, run the Hub setup again and select the current Amnesia folder.

games.GameInfoText: Among the Sleep: Enhanced Edition is a new and improved version of the award winning first person horror adventure. In the game you play as a small child trapped in a weird nightmare where you go looking for your mom.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The mod translates tracked controller input to keyboard and mouse; the game's controller mode is not used.
LaunchIssues.Label: Motion controllers are connected but movement does not work
Steps: Keep the game in keyboard and mouse mode.
Test movement with the left stick; it sends the game's W, A, S and D keys.

games.Quip: Teddy said he would keep you safe. He did not mention bedtime overtime.
games.Title: Among the Sleep VR

games.Author: Anomaly VR Team
games.GameInfoText: Welcome to the most complete and immersive S.T.A.L.K.E.R. experience yet. S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Anomaly is a free, stand-alone mod built on the 64-bit X-Ray engine, reinvigorated and enhanced to deliver the definitive survival sandbox in the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The AoE VR launcher has recovery controls for its settings and shader cache.
LaunchIssues.Label: Anomaly VR rendering looks wrong after an update
Steps: Open the AoE VR launcher with Start in VR in the Hub.
Use Reset settings and Clear shaders in the launcher, then check the selected VR runtime and start the game again.

games.Title: Anomaly VR
_UninstallGuide: Close Anomaly VR and its launcher before changing files.
This entry uses a separate VR build. Before removing 'C:\games\Anomaly VR', back up saves, settings, game dumps, ROMs and any other files you supplied or created there.
Use Open game folder and verify that it is the dedicated VR copy, not your normal Steam, GOG, Epic or original game folder.
Only after that check, remove the dedicated VR folder and its shortcut. Never delete the original game or source dump.

games.Author: GAMMA VR Team
games.GameInfoText: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. GAMMA is a free, standalone, hardcore survival modification for S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Anomaly. It combines over 400 mods into an immersive gameplay experience where you must repair and craft your own gear and fight for survival in the dangerous Zone.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The GAMMA VR start script regenerates the Mod Organizer profile settings on first run after installation or update.
LaunchIssues.Label: GAMMA VR still shows the old profile after an update
Steps: Close GAMMA and Mod Organizer.
Use Start in VR in the Hub to run GAMMA VR.bat once. Start the game from the profile it opens.

games.ModRequiredFile: mods\Wearable Devices PDA Messages v7.4.4 - VR Version realzelda414\meta.ini
games.Quip: Into the Zone, stalker - GAMMA and all. The atom hums.

games.Author: gborgogno
games.GameInfoText: Experience true combat gameplay in a massive military sandbox. Deploy with a wide variety of single- and multiplayer content, a massive arsenal of modern weapons and vehicles, and limitless opportunities for content creation. Authentic, diverse, open - Arma 3 sends you to war.

LaunchIssues.Guess: Arma needs FreeTrack and the active A3VR variant to pass head tracking to the game.
LaunchIssues.Label: Flat or head-locked view
Steps: Enable FreeTrack in Arma, then use Recenter HMD + Aim in gameplay.
If FreeTrack is missing, close Arma and use the A3VR launcher to open the official Arma launcher.

games.Notice: Early community alpha: this is a hybrid OpenXR bridge, not a native VR port. Both eyes currently receive the same comfort-mono image, and BattlEye must remain disabled.
games.Quip: Someone already took the high ground. It is always the sniper.
games.Title: Arma 3 VR
UninstallSteps: Disable 'A3VR - Arma 3 Hybrid VR' in the official Arma 3 Launcher.
Delete the '@A3VR_Hybrid' folder from your Arma 3 game folder if you installed the GitHub version.
If you used the Workshop version, unsubscribe from it in Steam instead.
The launcher backs up the Arma configuration and player profile before changing them; restore those backup copies if you also want to undo its FOV and graphics changes.
_UninstallGuide: Disable 'A3VR - Arma 3 Hybrid VR' in the official Arma 3 Launcher.
Delete the '@A3VR_Hybrid' folder from your Arma 3 game folder if you installed the GitHub version.
If you used the Workshop version, unsubscribe from it in Steam instead.
The launcher backs up the Arma configuration and player profile before changing them; restore those backup copies if you also want to undo its FOV and graphics changes.

games.Author: cmpayc
games.GameInfoText: This critically acclaimed first-person RPG from Arkane Studios takes the player on an amazing journey into the fantasy world of Arx. Arx is wrought with turmoil, brought to the brink of destruction by a violent war.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The log identifies which OpenXR runtime the game found and why it could not start VR.
LaunchIssues.Label: Arx Libertatis starts on the monitor only
Steps: Start the VR runtime and connect the headset before launching. For Virtual Desktop, the mod author advises installing SteamVR or selecting runtime=steamvr under [vr] in cfg.ini.
After exiting, check the OpenXR lines in Saved Games\Arx Libertatis\arx.log.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The output device may still be set to speakers.
LaunchIssues.Label: Arx Libertatis plays sound through the PC
Steps: Select the headset audio output in Windows or in Options > Audio.

games.Quip: The runes are in your hands now.
games.Title: Arx Fatalis VR

The original game, saves, settings and changed files remain.
_UninstallGuide: Use Uninstall now to remove unchanged Hub-owned files from the separate Arx VR folder.
The original game, saves, settings and changed files remain.

games.Author: Vostyok / hh79
games.GameInfoText: Ashes 2063 is a free, post-apocalyptic total conversion for GZDoom by Vostyok - build-style ruins and fast Doom combat with a Stalker and Fallout flavour. This entry adds motion controls through gzdoomvr, an OpenVR fork of GZDoom by hh79. Includes the Enriched campaign, Afterglow and the Hard Reset expansion.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The GZDoomVR author recommends a SteamVR community binding that exposes more buttons to the engine.
LaunchIssues.Label: Valve Index buttons are missing in GZDoomVR
Steps: In SteamVR Controller Bindings for GZDoomVR, choose Index Controller Bindings by gameflorist.
Return to GZDoomVR's controls menu and assign the actions you need.

games.Quip: Tune in to Spire Radio, scavenger - the wasteland is hungry tonight.
games.Title: Ashes 2063 VR

Use Open game folder and verify that it is the dedicated VR copy, not your normal Steam, GOG, Epic or original game folder.
Only after that check, remove the dedicated VR folder and its shortcut. Never delete the original game or source dump.

Steps: Add -force-d3d11 to the game's Steam launch options and restart.
If the log instead says the VR device is not enabled, rerun the Hub installer to restore the game asset patch.

games.Author: JayBiggsGMG
games.GameInfoText: Battlefield 1942 is a classic World War II first-person shooter that lets you fight across large battlefields as infantry or take control of tanks, aircraft, ships, and other vehicles.

LaunchIssues.Guess: Borderless1942 can interrupt VR presentation when Battlefield 1942 switches processes.
LaunchIssues.Label: VR disappears after changing maps
Steps: If installed, disable Borderless1942 in the Moongamers Battlefield 1942 Options tool.
Relaunch through BFVR and try the map change again. The logs beside BFVR.exe are loader.log and BFVRPresenter-game.log.

games.Notice: Battlefield 1942 is no longer sold anywhere - you need your own copy.
games.NoticeUrlLabel: You can find helpful information in the Community Guide
games.Quip: Someone already took the plane. They always do.
games.Title: Battlefield 1942 VR
UninstallSteps: Close Battlefield 1942 and BFVR.
Run the mod's own uninstaller: Battlefield 1942\BFVR\unins000.exe. It removes the BFVR folder it created.
Everything BFVR installed lives in that one BFVR\ subfolder - no game file was ever replaced, so there is nothing to restore.
BF42++ is a separate prerequisite, not part of BFVR. Leave bf42++.dll, bf42++.exe and bf42++BlackScreen.exe in place if you still want it, or delete those three files to remove it as well.
Your VR settings were in BFVR\UserConfig.txt and go with the folder.

If the installer set 'Run as administrator' for BFVR.exe or bf42++.exe (it offers that when the game sits under Program Files), undo it in the file's Properties - Compatibility tab, or it stays for that account.
_UninstallGuide: Close Battlefield 1942 and BFVR.
Run the mod's own uninstaller: Battlefield 1942\BFVR\unins000.exe. It removes the BFVR folder it created.
Everything BFVR installed lives in that one BFVR\ subfolder - no game file was ever replaced, so there is nothing to restore.
BF42++ is a separate prerequisite, not part of BFVR. Leave bf42++.dll, bf42++.exe and bf42++BlackScreen.exe in place if you still want it, or delete those three files to remove it as well.
Your VR settings were in BFVR\UserConfig.txt and go with the folder.

If the installer set 'Run as administrator' for BFVR.exe or bf42++.exe (it offers that when the game sits under Program Files), undo it in the file's Properties - Compatibility tab, or it stays for that account.

games.GameInfoText: A unique psychological action thriller delivered by A-list Hollywood performances by Elliot Page and Willem Dafoe, Beyond: Two Souls takes you on a thrilling journey across the globe as you play out the remarkable life of Jodie Holmes.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The mod preserves a different file for crashes and for runs that stalled without a crash report.
LaunchIssues.Label: Beyond: Two Souls crashes or freezes before VR starts
Steps: For a crash, find the newest crash_<date>.txt under b2svr_logs\crash_reports in the game folder.
For a freeze or missing VR, copy b2svr_logs\b2svr.log after quitting. If you have already restarted, also check b2svr.prev.log.

games.Quip: Two souls. One new point of view.
games.Title: Beyond: Two Souls VR

The game, saves, personal b2svr.ini and logs stay in place.
_UninstallGuide: Close Beyond: Two Souls, then choose Uninstall now to remove unchanged Hub-owned VR files and restore earlier same-name files.
The game, saves, personal b2svr.ini and logs stay in place.

games.FlatVRPublisherInstructions: InkVR: choose PLAY IN VR or PLAY WITHOUT VR in the publisher launcher. Team Beef Depot uses its separate desktop shortcut.
games.GameInfoText: Bendy and the Ink Machine® is the first person puzzle action horror game that will forever ruin your childhood love of cartoons.

LaunchIssues.Guess: Very long paths can prevent Windows from starting the launcher.
LaunchIssues.Label: InkVR Launcher will not open
Steps: If the downloaded InkVR launcher will not open, extract its complete package to a short path such as C:\Games\InkVR. Keep InkVR Launcher.exe and InkVR-Payload together.
If the Hub-installed copy is affected, leave its payload in place and use a shorter Steam library path for the game before reinstalling InkVR.

games.Quip: Dreams come to life. So does the ink.
games.Title: Bendy VR
UninstallSteps: Close Bendy and InkVR Launcher. Uninstall now removes unchanged Hub-owned InkVR files from the current game and restores protected same-name originals. Edited settings, saves and unknown files are kept.

See the mod's Controls section for the default actions.

Steps: Connect the headset to the active OpenXR runtime. At the game's main menu, press F8.
If CWVR shows a failure dialog, open the log from that dialog and check the runtime error.

games.Title: Content Warning VR
_UninstallGuide: Close Content Warning VR and its launcher before changing files.
For temporary flat play, use the Flat / VR switch on this page. It parks the VR loader or plugin and is fully reversible.
Remove only the VR-specific plugin path or parked counterpart that applies to this install: 'BepInEx\plugins\CWVR\CWVR.dll'.

Do not delete the whole BepInEx folder, Plugins folder, config folder, or winhttp.dll while another mod may use them. Those are shared loader components, not proof that every file belongs to this VR mod.

For a completely clean loader removal, compare the installed files with the package on the linked mod page and remove only matching package files. A store file check can restore changed game files, but it does not reliably remove added mod files.

Steps: Disable the Toolkit for Cruelty Squad, then restart the game.
For Virtual Desktop, ALVR or WMR, follow the mod guide's SteamVR OpenXR setup if the game still opens only on the monitor.

LaunchIssues.Guess: For WMR, Virtual Desktop and ALVR the mod author documents a SteamVR OpenXR setup.
LaunchIssues.Label: Game opens on the monitor without headset output

Connect the headset through SteamVR, then restart Cruelty Squad.

games.Title: Cruelty Squad VR
_UninstallGuide: Close Cruelty Squad VR and its launcher before changing files.
The Hub verifies the VR installation with 'openxr_loader.dll'. This identifies the mod but is not automatically a complete removal list.
Open the linked mod page below and compare its current package or author removal section with the files in your game folder. Remove only files confirmed to belong to this VR mod.

If the mod replaced an original game file and supplied no backup or uninstaller, preserve your settings and use the store launcher repair/verify command. Verification restores original files but may leave added mod files behind.
Never uninstall the base game or delete the whole game folder just to remove a VR mod.

games.Author: dariulone
games.GameInfoText: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in the dark future of Night City — a dangerous megalopolis obsessed with power, glamor, and ceaseless body modification.

LaunchIssues.Guess: An active R.E.A.L. VR DXGI proxy can conflict with CP_VRPort's RED4ext hook.
LaunchIssues.Label: Current 2.5: VR stops after switching mods
Steps: If you previously installed R.E.A.L. VR, disable it using its own removal instructions.
Confirm its DXGI proxy is no longer active in bin\x64, then launch CP_VRPort again.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The mod needs a runtime that exposes Vive tracker roles to OpenXR.
LaunchIssues.Label: Current 2.5: Vive trackers missing in calibration
Steps: Use SteamVR as the OpenXR runtime for Vive trackers. In Manage Vive Trackers, assign Waist, Left Foot and Right Foot.
Enable xr_vive_trackers=1 in vrport.ini before launching. Load a save, then start full-body calibration from the VR settings.

games.Quip: Wake up, samurai - Night City won't burn itself down.
games.Title: Cyberpunk 2077
UninstallSteps: For temporary flat play, use the Flat / VR switch on this page. It parks the route's VR plugin, the native hook needed to activate the port.

For full removal, use Uninstall Now here (or run PCVR-Cyberpunk\Uninstall VR.cmd in the selected game folder). The owned-file uninstaller removes this route and restores backed-up originals. The Hub keeps superseded 0.1.6 scripts and QuickBoot in a game-local legacy backup.
Leave the frameworks (RED4ext, Cyber Engine Tweaks, redscript) in place if other mods use them.

Current only requires RED4ext 1.31.0 or newer. The separate 2.31 Depot uses pinned frameworks and More Occluders Scripted v0.3 from Nexus. The first VR launch merges graphics, bindings, HUD and comfort settings into UserSettings.json after a dated backup; language, audio, difficulty and saves are preserved.
No base game file is modified, so a Steam verify is not needed.

games.GameInfoText: Scavenge, craft and survive in a cursed land styled like an 1980s horror comic. Use stealth and sound against creatures that hunt in the dark.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The default collision mode requires a hit with the weapon. The mod also has a swing-triggered mode.

games.GameInfoText: Explore the ancient, mysterious world of Journey as you soar above ruins and glide across sands to discover its secrets.

LaunchIssues.Label: Black screen on launch with Steam Frame

games.Notice: Steam Journey is the publisher-tested route. Epic is offered experimentally only when no Steam copy is found. Select SteamVR as OpenXR runtime and connect the headset before launch. Steam Frame requires Steam Link VR or the game may wait on a black screen.
games.Quip: Every journey begins with a single step.

games.Author: Abyss-c0re / Doom Slayer
games.GameInfoText: Garry's Mod is a physics sandbox. There aren't any predefined aims or goals. We give you the tools and leave you to play.

LaunchIssues.Guess: VRMod needs the 64-bit game, the Workshop addon and a loaded map.
LaunchIssues.Label: Garry's Mod stays flat or F2 does not show VRMod
Steps: In Steam Properties > Betas, choose x86-64. Start SteamVR, choose the 64-bit game and load a Sandbox map.
Check that the VRMod Workshop addon is subscribed and enabled. If F2 is unbound, check that Steam Launch Options include +exec autoexec.cfg, then restart.

games.Title: Garry's Mod VR
_UninstallGuide: Close Garry's Mod VR and its launcher before changing files.
The Hub verifies the VR installation with 'garrysmod\lua\bin\gmcl_vrmod_win64.dll'. This identifies the mod but is not automatically a complete removal list.
Open the linked mod page below and compare its current package or author removal section with the files in your game folder. Remove only files confirmed to belong to this VR mod.

If the mod replaced an original game file and supplied no backup or uninstaller, preserve your settings and use the store launcher repair/verify command. Verification restores original files but may leave added mod files behind.
Never uninstall the base game or delete the whole game folder just to remove a VR mod.

LaunchIssues.Label: Virtual Desktop shows the green background instead of your room

Enable Virtual Desktop passthrough color replacement for the mod's green background.

games.Quip: The cards are finally in your hands. Try not to exhaust them all at once.

games.GameInfoText: Gran Turismo 2 combines arcade races with a full simulation career, hundreds of cars, licence challenges and tuning. This native PCVR port prepares Arcade and Simulation from original PlayStation discs that you own; no game data is included.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The native port needs a complete disc image with 2352-byte sectors.
LaunchIssues.Label: Gran Turismo 2 will not load the disc image
Steps: Use a complete BIN/CUE image of a supported disc revision from your own copy.
Check the publisher's compatibility and installation links before retrying.

games.Notice: Use your own supported complete Gran Turismo 2 Arcade or Simulation disc image. A 2048-byte ISO omits required audio/video sectors. This PCVR route stays pinned to v0.9.1 using the complete reviewed native Windows package.
games.Quip: There are no shortcuts to the podium, only apexes.
games.Title: Gran Turismo 2 PCVR

Remove the PCVR player and launchers from the dedicated runtime folder only after checking they are the generated files. Keep arcade/simulation disc data, saves and user settings for a future install.

games.GameInfoText: Grand Theft Auto V for PC offers players the option to explore the award-winning world of Los Santos and Blaine County in resolutions of up to 4k and beyond, as well as the chance to experience the game running at 60 frames per second.

LaunchIssues.Guess: DeployAbi's launcher compares the installed GTA V Legacy build against the one supported by that mod release.
LaunchIssues.Label: GTAVR Motion starts GTA V without VR
Steps: Check the build comparison on the first GTAVR launcher screen.
If it reports a mismatch, follow the publisher's matching GTA V Legacy and ScriptHookV instructions for the installed GTAVR version.

games.Quip: Pull off the heist, outrun the stars, and own the streets of Los Santos.
games.Title: Grand Theft Auto V VR
UninstallSteps: For DeployAbi GTAVR, open VRLaunch\DeployAbi\GTAVR-Setup-and-Play.exe and click its own Uninstall action. It uses gtavr_install_manifest.txt to remove only its recorded payload.
The Hub's three launch buttons switch safely without uninstalling: DeployAbi parks RealVR.asi and GTAVR.asi; either R.E.A.L. button creates gtavr.disabled so DeployAbi stays inert.

To remove the older R.E.A.L. setup completely, compare against its installed package and remove only its files: RealVR.ini, RealVR.asi or RealVR.asi.off, the asi folder, RealRepo, RealConfig.bat and its launch files. Restore a package-created settings_ori.xml if present.
ScriptHookV.dll, dinput8.dll and openvr_api.dll are shared loader names and may belong to the other setup or another mod. Do not delete them without verifying ownership.
Never uninstall GTA V or delete the whole game folder just to remove either VR mod. Saves and Rockstar profile data are not part of the Hub removal steps.

games.GameInfoText: Welcome to Vice City. Welcome to the 1980s. From the decade of big hair, excess and pastel suits comes a story of one man's rise to the top of the criminal pile.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The port offers separate stereo and cinema screen modes for cutscenes.

Steps: Close the game and run CUTSCENE_MODE.bat from the mod. Select reVC.exe if prompted, then choose 1 - STEREO.
To restore the previous presentation, rerun the helper and choose 2 - CINEMA SCREEN.

games.Quip: Rise through the pastel-soaked 80s and take the whole coast.
games.Title: GTA Vice City VR
UninstallSteps: Open your Vice City game folder.
Delete the files the Vice City VR archive supplied, plus 'models\vrhands'.

If BASE runtime setup installed Streamline/DLSS files, use the publisher's SETUP_RUNTIME.bat Restore action and its dlss5-backups before removing those dependencies. Do not delete shared DLL names without checking ownership.

If you installed the optional HD Model Pack, do NOT delete the game's whole 'models' folder. The pack merged files from modelsets\modern\models and modelsets\modern\txd into the game's 'models' and 'txd' folders.

For every original file the HD pack replaced, the installer kept a <name>.hubbak beside it. Delete the HD replacement and rename its .hubbak copy back. Files added only by the pack can be identified from the same ZIP and deleted individually.
Delete the 'GTA Vice City VR' shortcut from your Desktop if you let the installer create one.
The original executable is not changed, so Vice City keeps working in flat mode.

games.Author: DSprtn
games.GameInfoText: GTFO is a hardcore cooperative horror shooter that throws you from gripping suspense to explosive action in a heartbeat. Stealth, strategy, and teamwork are necessary to survive in your deadly, underground prison. Work together or die together.

LaunchIssues.Guess: Existing SteamVR bindings can lack actions added by the GTFO VR release.
LaunchIssues.Label: Radial menus or snap turn do not respond
Steps: Open SteamVR → Settings → Controllers → Manage Controller Bindings → GTFO VR.
Assign the radial menus and snap-turn actions for your controller, then try them in-game.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The publisher documents texture memory and optional VR upscaling as things to check.
LaunchIssues.Label: Crash when entering a level or changing resolution
Steps: Lower the game's texture resolution before entering a level.
If you enabled upscaling through VR Performance Toolkit, try disabling that option and restart.

games.Title: GTFO VR
_UninstallGuide: Close GTFO VR and its launcher before changing files.
For temporary flat play, use the Flat / VR switch on this page. It parks the VR loader or plugin and is fully reversible.
Remove only the VR-specific plugin path or parked counterpart that applies to this install: 'BepInEx\plugins\GTFO_VR.dll'.

Do not delete the whole BepInEx folder, Plugins folder, config folder, or winhttp.dll while another mod may use them. Those are shared loader components, not proof that every file belongs to this VR mod.

For a completely clean loader removal, compare the installed files with the package on the linked mod page and remove only matching package files. A store file check can restore changed game files, but it does not reliably remove added mod files.

LaunchIssues.Guess: Steam or the EA app can restore the original loader over MEVR's loader.
LaunchIssues.Label: MEVR: game opens flat after a game update or repair
Steps: Close the game. Open MEVR-Setup.exe from the downloaded release with its payload folder next to it.
Choose Repair, then start MEVR again.

LaunchIssues.Guess: The MEVR developer reproduced a launch loop caused by the game's anti-aliasing settings in an older build.
LaunchIssues.Label: MEVR 0.1.x: VR launch keeps retrying
Steps: Update the motion-control MEVR mod.

LaunchIssues.Guess: R.E.A.L. needs RealConfig after a manual install or update. A fresh game also needs one normal flat launch first.

_UninstallGuide: Close Dark Souls II VR and its launcher before changing files.
For temporary flat play, use the Flat / VR switch on this page. It parks RealRepo and the injector reversibly; it does not remove the game.
The Hub detects this installation through 'Game\RealRepo\RealVR64.dll', 'Game\RealRepo_\RealVR64.dll'. Treat these as markers, not as permission to delete their parent game folders.

For a full removal, use the file list supplied with the installed R.E.A.L. package. Remove only Luke Ross files and restore any package-created *_ori or backup file; shared injectors such as dxgi.dll may belong to ReShade or another mod.
Never uninstall the base game or delete the whole game folder just to remove R.E.A.L. VR.

This VR build renders the whole game inside the headset with full head tracking, on top of Golden Balloon, akratch's PC port - you bring your own US 1.1 or EU 1.1 ROM.

LaunchIssues.Guess: Golden Balloon builds its game data from an owned Nintendo 64 ROM.
LaunchIssues.Label: Diddy Kong Racing VR asks for a cartridge dump
Steps: Use Start in VR to open Multiverse VR Hub, choose Diddy Kong Racing and select Play.
When the port asks for game data, select your own supported Diddy Kong Racing ROM. Use an unmodified dump if import rejects a patched one.

games.Quip: Car, hovercraft or plane - Wizpig laughs at all three.
games.Title: Diddy Kong Racing VR
_UninstallGuide: Close Diddy Kong Racing VR and its launcher before changing files.
This entry uses a separate VR build. Before removing 'C:\Games\Diddy Kong Racing VR', back up saves, settings, game dumps, ROMs and any other files you supplied or created there.
Use Open game folder and verify that it is the dedicated VR copy, not your normal Steam, GOG, Epic or original game folder.
Only after that check, remove the dedicated VR folder and its shortcut. Never delete the original game or source dump.
